item.tib: zur za ye shes mtshon cha
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa yang / rig 'dzin rje la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyong rnams la bzod par gsol/ 'di bris dge ba bsod nams mchog mthu byin stobs dang rdzu 'phrul gyis/ bdag sogs phyi rabs gang zag rnams/ nyes pa'i skyon rnams rab grol nas/ legs pa phun sum 'tshog 'gyur te/ tshe yi rig 'dzin sa thob ste/ kha ba can gyi bod yul du/ bstan pa mi nub dar rgyas nas/ nam mkha'i gdod nas dag pa la/ nyi shar ci bzhin bkra shis shog/
